MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Dot and smart plug add useful capabilities to my connected home: hands-free control alongside my Fire TV devices and scheduling a lamp.",
    "The HDMI cable fits my television setup, although I would only choose it if I needed an extra connection or more cable length."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another HD Fire TV Stick adds little because I already have a 4K stick and a Fire TV television; the curved monitor similarly duplicates my existing Acer monitor without a clear benefit.",
    "The internal SSD, memory kit, and drive enclosure assume upgrade or storage projects I have not expressed, while the charging cables require device compatibility I cannot confirm.",
    "The mouse does not support the television, recording, or home security activities that matter to me right now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in specific home electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any computer accessory or component.",
    "Owning a streaming device or monitor seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest another similar device, even when it offers no clear improvement."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already own matters: useful additions appeal more than replacements or duplicates without a clear purpose.",
    "My recent purchases point toward television, video recording, and home security needs, rather than a desktop upgrade project.",
    "Accessories only become compelling when they solve a concrete need and work with my existing equipment; a plausible connection alone is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly understood my connected-home interests but extended them too broadly into duplicate devices and unrelated computer upgrades."
}
